Q1: The implement guard only reads a multiline `files_touched` block written by a trusted author (the pipeline account or an OWNER, MEMBER or COLLABORATOR), and the pipeline cannot rewrite this issue's body itself. How should the allowlist be fixed before `/approved`?
Choices:
A. A trusted author edits this issue's body to add the block below exactly (two-space indent, each path on its own line), then approves. (RECOMMENDED)
```
files_touched:
  - scripts/implement_heal_preflight.sh
  - tests/test_implement_heal_preflight.py
```
B. Close this issue and have a trusted author open a new maintenance issue whose body contains the block in A, plus the same spec.
C. Leave the body as it is and proceed anyway. **Note:** the guard will refuse the commit again and the issue will be labelled `ai:scope-blocked`, the same as #6788.
